races.prior_note: independent, Democrat also on the ballot: prior widened x2

notes.house: mu = 1.1 + 0.95*lean + 4.3*inc + E (lean = 2 x Cook PVI 2026), fundraising: + 1.26 x log(D / R individual contributions through June 30, $10k floor) — out of sample it cut competitive-seat error 5.5 % (2018) and 3.8 % (2022), and moves incumbency from 4.6 to 3.2; race polls from the state pages blended by precision (per-poll sd 5.6, shared 4.3); every race poll (House and Senate) is corrected for its pollster's measured lean (538's 2016-22 record, shrunk) or, failing that, its sponsor tag: D-sponsored polls ran 4.3 too Democratic and R-sponsored 4.1 too Republican against the non-partisan polls of the same race (1998-2022, same sign every cycle), and count at 0.58 weight; polls with more than 12 % undecided carry up to 26 % more error, a third candidate at 10 %+ 27 % more; LV and RV race polls are not adjusted (94 % of late race polls are LV; the generic-ballot fit carries LV/RV/adult offsets); Hispanic/Asian swing since 2024: + 15 x centred Hispanic CVAP share (Cubans at 1/4) + 11 x centred Asian share, before the poll blend (2025 NJ/VA governor and CA Prop 50 reversed the 2020-24 shift fully, specials did not; centred so the national environment is unchanged - low-Hispanic seats move about -2); errors t5: national 2.9, state 2.5, urban 2.0, Hispanic / Cuban / Asian group factors 15 per unit share, residual 5.0
notes.senate: mu = 1.4 + 0.80*E + 0.76*lean + 10.4*inc, prior sd 13.4 (refit on 326 races 2006-2024; was 0.5*E from 2018+2022 only), polls from the Wikipedia race pages (per-poll sd 4.2, shared 5.0); only polls of the candidates actually on the ballot, full field where a third candidate polls 10 %+; the margin is the main challenger minus the Republican — an independent where no Democrat is on the ballot (NE, ID, SD) or the independent leads the Democrat (MT). Independent wins are not counted as Democratic seats. An independent with no Democrat on the ballot gets the prior +20.3 (every serious one since 1976 beat the D-v-R prior by 17.5-23.4: Orman 2014, McMullin 2022, Osborn 2024); with a Democrat also running (MT) the prior is widened x2 instead; Hispanic/Asian swing term as in the House (15 x centred Hispanic CVAP share, Cubans at 1/4, 11 x Asian; state shares vs national), mean and group shocks both damped by the Senate's national slope 0.5
